0.original: Qhoterl Pasol has a nose for perfumes.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested items to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: You're doubtless aware, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, that we Qitari possess eminently keen noses. Even in pitch-black darkness, we can discern one of our own from another and locate them.

49.original: However, the caverns we explore can be filled with strange gases that confuse our sense of smell. To cut through this haze, we've taken to using a special perfume, which I would concoct with your assistance.

50.original: At Mjrl's Regret, it is possible to find amber─a key ingredient in the perfume. Will you not mine three pieces for me?

51.original: At Mjrl's Regret, it is possible to find lavender─a key ingredient in the perfume. Will you not gather three sprigs for me?

52.original: In the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta dwells a fish called the pirarucu─a key ingredient in the perfume. Will you not catch one for me?

53.original: That will suffice to make a goodly batch of the stuff to help keep us safe during our explorations. Much obliged, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!

54.original: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.

55.original: It is possible to find amber at Mjrl's Regret. I'd be much obliged if you could obtain three pieces for me.

56.original: It is possible to find lavender at Mjrl's Regret. I'd be much obliged if you could obtain three sprigs for me.

57.original: It is possible to find pirarucu in the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta. I'd be much obliged if you could catch one for me.

58.original: <sniff> <sniff> You've returned with what I seek, and no mistake. Now, if I might examine it...

59.original: My, such a potent smell! This will serve most splendidly, oh yes!

60.original: With a spot of refining, it will make a scent that is unmistakable in the caverns. Hehe, 'tis time once again to put my skills as a perfumer to use!
